title: Brassicaceae seeds inhibit Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilm and quorum sensing signal production by targeting the las quorum sensing system.
authors: Xie, Juntao; Huang, Yujing; Wang, Likang; Chen, Honggeng; Xia, Zhiyun; Yu, Xin; Yang, Jianni; Xu, Jun; Fan, Hongxia; Zheng, Junxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究十字花科种子提取物抑制铜绿假单胞菌生物膜与群体感应，虽含分子对接但对象为细菌蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Wasabia japonica and Brassica juncea, members of the Brassicaceae family, are valued not only as edible vegetables but also for their medicinal potential, largely attributed to the antimicrobial properties of their seed oils. The pathogenicity and resilience of Pseudomonas aeruginosa (P. aeruginosa) are closely linked to its biofilm formation and quorum sensing (QS)-regulated virulence, highlighting the need for novel anti-virulence agents. This study investigated the ability of Wasabia japonica seeds (WJS) and Brassica juncea seeds (BJS) extracts to inhibit biofilm formation and QS-mediated phenotypes in P. aeruginosa PAO1. At sub-inhibitory concentrations (</=32 mug/mL), both extracts significantly reduced biofilm formation (60.02% and 64.23%, respectively), impaired swimming and swarming motility, and downregulated key QS genes (lasI, lasR, lasB, pqsA). Against two clinical MDR isolates (PAO1-MDR-PA1 and PAO1-MDR-PA20), WJS reduced biofilm formation by 35.89% and 41.13%, while BJS reduced by 34.89% and 46.90%. Fluorescent reporter assays further confirmed the inhibition of lasB and pqsA promoter activity. Chemical profiling by GC-MS identified 6 and 13 major components in WJS and BJS, respectively. Molecular docking demonstrated that WJS and BJS fatty acids inhibit virulence by simultaneously targeting LasB and LasR. Our findings demonstrate that WJS and BJS specifically target the las and pqs QS systems to attenuate virulence in P. aeruginosa. These results support their potential as natural anti-biofilm agents and as therapeutic options against clinical multidrug-resistant isolates, while also providing a foundation for developing next-generation QS inhibitors.
abstract_zh: Wasabia japonica和Brassica juncea是十字花科（Brassicaceae）家族的成员，不仅作为食用蔬菜具有价值，还因其药用潜力而受到重视，这主要归因于其种子油的抗菌特性。铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa）的致病性和抵抗力与其生物膜形成和群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）调控的毒力密切相关，凸显了对新型抗毒力因子的需求。本研究探讨了Wasabia japonica种子（WJS）和Brassica juncea种子（BJS）提取物抑制铜绿假单胞菌PAO1中生物膜形成和QS介导表型的能力。在亚抑制浓度（≤32 μg/mL）下，两种提取物均显著减少生物膜形成（分别减少60.02%和64.23%），损害泳动和群集运动能力，并下调关键QS基因（lasI、lasR、lasB、pqsA）。针对两株临床多重耐药（MDR）分离株（PAO1-MDR-PA1和PAO1-MDR-PA20），WJS将生物膜形成分别减少35.89%和41.13%，而BJS分别减少34.89%和46.90%。荧光报告基因实验进一步证实了lasB和pqsA启动子活性的抑制。通过GC-MS化学分析，在WJS和BJS中分别鉴定出6种和13种主要成分。分子对接（molecular docking）表明，WJS和BJS脂肪酸通过同时靶向LasB和LasR来抑制毒力。我们的研究结果表明，WJS和BJS特异性靶向las和pqs QS系统以减弱铜绿假单胞菌的毒力。这些结果支持其作为天然抗生物膜因子及针对临床多重耐药分离株的治疗选择的潜力，同时为开发下一代QS抑制剂提供了基础。
